landing.title: A clearer view of your term.
landing.lead: See what needs attention and how your term is going. Choose which shared class activities to add to your own calendar. Grades and absences stay personal.
landing.featuresTitle: A place to understand your term.
landing.featuresLead: Home puts upcoming work first and gives you a way into your recorded grades. Everything else stays close.
landing.feature1Text: Record grades and see averages and trends based on the data you entered.
landing.feature2Text: Your own assignments and tests, alongside class activities you chose to add.
landing.feature3Text: Members share activities. Your completion and choices in your calendar remain personal.
landing.feature4Text: A diary already opened on this device remains available offline; personal changes wait to sync.
landing.privacyTitle: Share class activities, keep your diary personal.
landing.privacyText: Only you can see your grades, averages, absences and personal notes. Class activities are visible to members; you choose which to bring into your calendar.
landing.personalData: Grades, absences and notes: only yours
landing.sharedActivity: Shared activities: visible to the class
landing.stepsTitle: Start with the information you need.
landing.step1Text: Set the dates and add the subjects you use.
landing.step2Text: Home shows upcoming work and a summary based on your entries.
landing.step3Text: If you belong to a class, choose which shared activities to follow in your calendar.
landing.faqIntro: A private space separate from class activities.
landing.faq1Q: Does it replace the school's official system?
landing.faq1A: No. iPagell is a personal tool and does not replace official school communications.
landing.faq2Q: Can the class see my grades?
landing.faq2A: No. Grades, absences, notes and progress stay private. The class sees only shared activities.
landing.faq3Q: Can I use it on my phone?
landing.faq3A: Yes. iPagell works in the browser; in compatible browsers you can also add it to your Home screen.
landing.faq4A: You can view a diary already saved on this device. Pending personal changes try to sync when you reconnect; shared activities need a connection.
landing.finalTitle: Make room for what matters this term.
landing.finalText: Open your personal diary and start with a subject or a deadline.
landing.opensource: iPagell is developed openly. Code and documentation are on GitHub.
landing.footer: A personal space for finding your way through the term. An independent project, not an official school record.

install.safariStepsLabel: Add iPagell to the Home Screen with Safari
install.safariStepOne: In Safari, tap Share (or Page Menu → Share).
install.safariStepTwo: Scroll and choose Add to Home Screen.
install.safariStepThree: Turn on Open as Web App if available, then tap Add.
install.chromeSteps: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu and choose Add to Home screen or Install app, if shown.
install.samsungSteps: In Samsung Internet, use the install icon in the toolbar or the Add to Home menu.
install.edgeSteps: In Edge, open the … menu and choose Add to phone, if available. This may create a Home Screen shortcut.
install.firefoxSteps: In Firefox, open the ⋮ menu and choose Add to Home screen. A shortcut will be created.
install.headline: iPagell, always one tap away
install.shortcutBody: Open it from your Home Screen with one tap. If you have already viewed the diary on this device, the saved copy may be available offline.
install.installedBody: Open it from your Home Screen for an app-like experience. The diary already saved on this device is available offline.
